_meta.description: Default rate-card templates (junior / medior / senior / partner) for Dutch consultancy administrations. Operator overrides per administration: these are starting-point defaults only. Rates are indicative; actual market rates vary by sector and administration.
_meta.note: effectiveTo: null means currently-valid (no expiry). Operator must set administrationId when seeding.

rateCards.description: Junior consultant (0–3 jaar ervaring). Indicatief Conduction-starttarief; operator stelt eigen tarief in.
Medior consultant (3–7 jaar ervaring). Indicatief Conduction-medior tarief; operator stelt eigen tarief in.
Senior consultant (7+ jaar ervaring). Indicatief Conduction-senior tarief; operator stelt eigen tarief in.
Partner / principal consultant. Indicatief Conduction-partner tarief; operator stelt eigen tarief in.
